SELECT DISTINCT ON (LOWER(title), LOWER(artist))
  id,
  title,
  artist,
  tg_chat_id,
  message_id
FROM pocketsound_files
WHERE is_searchable = true
  AND (to_tsvector('simple', LOWER(title || ' ' || artist || ' ' || file_name)) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', '{{ $json.query }}'))
ORDER BY LOWER(title), LOWER(artist), id DESC
LIMIT 8 OFFSET {{ $json.offset }};
